estimates.name: Madeira – Pico do Arieiro→Pico Ruivo, levadas
estimates.closure_note: Year-round. Best value Nov–Dec when the Alps are shut.

estimates.name: Serra da Estrela
estimates.closure_note: Snow possible in Dec – can be a bonus.

estimates.name: High Atlas – Imlil & Jebel Toubkal
estimates.closure_note: Dec needs crampons + guide (snow). Refuges provide bunks.

estimates.name: Calanques (Marseille)
estimates.closure_note: Fire-risk closures end in Oct; perfect autumn–winter.

estimates.name: Lauterbrunnen / Grindelwald / Jungfrau
estimates.closure_note: Golden Sept–Oct; Nov is dead season (many lifts shut); Dec snowy but scenic.

estimates.name: Hallstatt / Dachstein (5 Fingers, Gosausee)
estimates.closure_note: Dachstein lifts run to late Oct.

estimates.name: Innsbruck – Nordkette, Stubai
estimates.closure_note: Autumn hiking to Oct; Dec = snow walking / Nordkette open.

estimates.name: Dolomites – Tre Cime, Seceda, Alpe di Siusi, Braies
estimates.closure_note: Huts & shuttle buses stop mid-Oct; lifts close ~early Oct.
